title: D2C Growth Associate
description:
### **About Barosi**

Barosi is a D2C food brand bringing traditional Indian food and authentic flavours to modern households. We are looking for a proactive and analytical D2C Executive to help manage and grow our direct-to-consumer business.

### **Role Overview**

The candidate will manage day-to-day Shopify operations, coordinate with the performance marketing team, track business performance, and identify opportunities to improve the D2C funnel and drive online sales.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Shopify & Website Management**

* Manage Shopify operations, including product listings, pricing, inventory visibility, collections, discount codes, and offers.
* Coordinate website updates, landing pages, banners, product launches, and campaign-related changes.
* Ensure accurate product information, pricing, and promotional details across the website.
* Identify website issues affecting customer experience and conversions, and coordinate technical fixes with developers or external partners.

**2. D2C Growth & Funnel Optimisation**

* Develop strategies to improve the customer journey, from website visits and product discovery to add-to-cart, checkout, and purchase.
* Analyse funnel drop-offs and identify opportunities to improve conversion rate, average order value (AOV), repeat purchases, and revenue.
* Plan product bundles, cross-selling, upselling, and promotional strategies to drive growth.
* Support customer retention initiatives and improve the overall shopping experience.

**3. Performance Marketing Coordination**

* Work closely with the media buying team to align campaigns, offers, creatives, landing pages, and business objectives.
* Ensure campaigns go live with the correct products, pricing, discount codes, and landing pages.
* Track campaign and website performance to identify opportunities for improving conversions and sales.
* Share customer behaviour and website insights to support campaign optimisation.

**4. Data Analysis & Business Reporting**

* Track key metrics, including revenue, website sessions, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, add-to-cart rate, checkout abandonment, and repeat purchase rate.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Analyse sales trends, product performance, customer behaviour, and campaign results.
* Identify gaps against targets and recommend data-backed actions to improve performance and profitability.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with performance marketing, creative, design, customer support, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure smooth execution.
* Manage timelines for campaigns, product launches, website updates, and promotional activities.
* Coordinate on inventory availability, order-related issues, cancellations, returns, and customer feedback.
* Ensure clear communication and timely completion of deliverables across teams.

**6. Retention & WhatsApp Marketing**

* Use Interakt or other WhatsApp marketing tools to plan and execute retention campaigns, promotional broadcasts, and offer communications.
* Coordinate customer communication for product launches, festive campaigns, special offers, and repeat purchase initiatives.
* Track campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve customer retention.

### **Requirements**

* Hands-on knowledge of Shopify and its day-to-day functionalities.
* Understanding of D2C business models, e-commerce operations, and online sales funnels.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, and performance marketing metrics.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritise effectively, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and growth-oriented mindset.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with a D2C brand, preferably in FMCG, food, beauty, or lifestyle.
* Familiarity with Shopify analytics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), CRM, email marketing, and WhatsApp marketing tools.
* Understanding of e-commerce profitability, contribution margins, discounts, returns, and cancellations.

### **Ideal Candidate**

Someone who understands how a D2C business operates, is comfortable working with numbers, and can turn strategies into execution. The candidate should be able to manage Shopify independently, coordinate across teams, and proactively identify opportunities to grow Barosi’s online business.

We are looking for a driven, persuasive, and target-oriented **Business Development Executive** who can connect with prospective customers, understand their learning goals, and convert leads into paying customers for our AI courses.

As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for driving B2C sales by engaging directly with individual customers, generating interest in our AI courses, nurturing prospective learners, and closing sales. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a strong sales mindset, and the ability to turn potential leads into revenue-generating opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with people, understands customer needs, and is motivated by achieving and exceeding sales targets.

**B2C Sales & Revenue Generation**

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable AI courses based on their interests, career goals, and learning needs.

**Lead Management & Conversion**

* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline by tracking leads at every stage of the sales cycle.
* Nurture interested prospects through consistent follow-ups, addressing their questions, and resolving objections.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  

The Builder Leadership Experience

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.  

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

Unleash Your Potential

description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

As Regional Business Development Manager (Accessories), you will drive Accessories retail growth across the assigned region by improving dealer performance, increasing accessory penetration, strengthening retail conversion, executing OEM-led initiatives, and achieving sales, profitability, customer satisfaction, and business development objectives. The role works closely with dealerships, Regional Sales Teams, ZAM, and cross-functional stakeholders to maximize Accessories Retail.
  
Business Performance Management
  

* Deliver regional Accessories retail and billing targets in coordination with RSMs and ASMs.
* Develop and execute regional business plans aligned with OEM growth objectives.
* Monitor dealer, MADB, and branch performance and drive corrective actions for underperforming locations.
* Track key business KPIs and ensure sustainable growth.

Dealer Network Development
  

* Strengthen Accessories business capability across dealerships.
* Conduct regular dealer reviews and performance assessments.
* Improve sales opportunities through enhanced display standards, retail processes, and customer engagement practices.

Sales & Retail Excellence
  

* Drive accessory attachment and penetration across vehicle models.
* Implement vehicle-wise and category-wise sales strategies.
* Improve retail conversion through dealership interventions, structured follow-ups, and process improvements.
* Identify, scale, and replicate best practices across the region.

Product & Category Management
  

* Promote OEM-approved accessories and support new product launches.
* Gather regional market insights and customer requirements to support product development.
* Ensure product availability and healthy inventory levels across dealerships.
* Coordinate with supply chain teams to minimize stock-outs and improve fulfillment.

Program Execution
  

* Plan and execute regional marketing activations, roadshows, and dealer-level promotional initiatives.
* Roll out sales campaigns, contests, promotions, and incentive programs.
* Ensure effective implementation of seasonal and strategic business initiatives.
* Monitor program effectiveness and ROI.

Training & Capability Building
  

* Conduct product, sales, and retail training for dealer sales consultants, accessories executives, workshop personnel, and management teams.
* Build dealer capability in accessory selling, upselling, and customer engagement.
* Support certification and dealer capability enhancement initiatives.

Stakeholder Management
  

* Collaborate with Regional Sales, Service, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Teams, and dealerships.
* Create synergies with vehicle marketing initiatives and service camps to promote accessories.
* Serve as the primary regional point of contact for Accessories business matters.
* Align OEM and dealer objectives to drive business outcomes.

Market Intelligence & Business Development
  

* Analyze competitor products, pricing, promotions, and market trends.
* Identify growth opportunities, emerging customer needs, and business development levers.
* Recommend strategic actions to improve market share, revenue, and profitability.

Governance & Compliance
  

* Ensure compliance with OEM policies, commercial guidelines, processes, and audit requirements.
* Maintain accurate forecasts, business reports, and performance dashboards.
* Drive adherence to quality, warranty, and customer service standards.

**KPIs**
--------

* Accessories Retail Target Achievement
* Retail Sales Growth
* Support Regional team for Accessories Billing Target Achievement
* Accessories Penetration (%)
* Vehicle Attachment Rate
* Category-wise Growth
* New Product Launch Success Rate
* Dealer Training Coverage
* Inventory Health & Availability
* Customer Satisfaction Metrics

---------------------------

We prefer a candidate with the following qualifications:

* Graduate in Engineering / Automobile / Mechanical / Business Administration.
* MBA (Marketing / Sales) preferred.

**General Experience**
----------------------

* 10-15 years of experience in Automobile Accessories, Aftermarket, Sales or Business Development.
* Experience in OEM, Automotive Retail, Tier-1 Supplier, or Automotive Accessories Industry preferred.
* Proven track record of managing dealer networks and achieving business targets.

**Competencies**
----------------

**Functional Competencies**

* Accessories Retail Management
* Dealer Network Management
* Sales Planning & Forecasting
* Market Intelligence

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Leadership & Influencing Skills
* Customer Orientation
* Result Focus
* Negotiation Skills
* Relationship Management
* Problem Solving

Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. ------------------

------------------

* Collaborate closely with Account Executives and the broader Sales team to ensure a smooth handoff of qualified opportunities
* Meet and work toward defined activity and performance targets, including prospect outreach, qualified meetings, and sales opportunities generated
* Continuously learn and develop a strong understanding of our products, customers, market, and sales process

**What You Have**
-----------------

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and conversational skills with the ability to confidently engage with customers
* A proactive and persistent approach to reaching and engaging prospects
* Strong listening and questioning skills with the ability to understand customer needs
* Ability to learn complex products and communicate their value in a simple and compelling way
* Strong interest in building a career in Sales and Business Development
* Comfortable working in a target driven and performance focused environment
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple prospects and follow ups
* Willingness to make outbound calls and engage in frequent customer conversations
* Ability to work effectively with a US based Sales organization and adapt to a fast paced environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Previous experience in Sales, Business Development, Lead Generation, Customer Success, Customer Service, or a similar customer facing role
* Experience with outbound calling, prospecting, lead qualification, or appointment setting
* Familiarity with CRM or sales engagement tools
* Understanding of B2B, B2C sales processes
* Experience working with US based customers or stakeholders
* Exposure to the healthcare, health technology, RCM, or SaaS industry

**Work Details:**

* Shift Detail: Night shift, (8:30 PM, IST - 5:30 AM, IST)

title: Managed Services Consultant - Sr
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining platform solutions across digital and voice channels. Focus on execution, operational stability, customer support, and ongoing platform adoption.

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Support configuration and maintenance of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions across chat, messaging, email, social, and voice channels.
* Execute platform updates aligned to defined solution blueprints, best practices, and core configuration architecture.
* Assist in configuring and maintaining routing logic, queues, IVR flows, case workflows, SLA rules, and escalations.
* Support bot workflows, automation rules, and bot-to-agent handoff configurations to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify basic platform gaps, configuration issues, and optimization opportunities, and recommend improvements aligned to customer requirements.
* Help maintain platform adoption by supporting users in understanding and using configured features effectively.
* Provide day-to-day support for post go-live enhancements, troubleshooting, and configuration changes.
* Assist in monitoring customer operations metrics such as SLA adherence, queue performance, response times, and agent productivity.
* Support basic API, CRM, and third-party integration activities, including validation and workflow coordination.
* Help onboard and train new agents, admins, and users on workflows, platform usage, and best practices.
* Work closely with Lead consultants and customer stakeholders to ensure configurations remain aligned to business needs and solution design.
* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.

**What Makes You Qualified?**

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco, or other contact center technologies.
* Experience with queues, routing, workflows, dashboards, SLA setup, or case management.
* Foundational understanding of IVR, telephony concepts, chatbot workflows, and platform automation.
* Basic knowledge of API, CRM integration concepts, and cross-system workflow dependencies.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and configuration support skills.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.
* Understanding of customer support operations and service KPIs.
* Experience supporting user training and onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Who You Are**

  

* Detail-oriented and hands-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer-facing, fast-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day-to-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO - Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Assistant Manager- AFR Import Operations
description:
**ABOUT AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS**

The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management, network offices, vendors, and customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As an integral part of the Air Freight Operations team, the role involves advancing import operational activities in alignment with the organization’s overarching goal. The focus is on delivering an exceptional customer experience, fostering collaboration with network offices, working on CW1 tool, and maximizing profitability through rigorous adherence to regulatory compliance.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Excellence**

* Enhance operational processes to foster consistent volume growth.
* Spearhead the implementation of new initiatives for maximizing operational efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with network offices to ensure optimal capacity procurement and utilization.
* Manage Delivery Order issuance and oversee Shipment Execution, including accurate invoicing, cost booking, claims handling, and customer complaint resolution with an intensely customer-centric approach.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including milestone updating and utilization of CW1 tools.
* Implement and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational performance and drive improvements.
* Manage and update your shipments via CW1 search grids and tasks.
* Efficiently address Inter-Company Issues and customer disputes to contribute to a healthy P & L result.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Be Proactive and Ensure Timestamp for Completeness & Timeliness
* Manage Complaints, Claims, Compliments - be responsive and available.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the air freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.

  

**Stakeholder Management**

* Oversee end to end process for a specific set of customers from booking to delivery.
* Cultivate and manage customer relationships, addressing grievances and ensuring overall billing quality and timeliness.
* Oversee relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, and network partners.

  

**Customer and Network Support**

* Register complaints related to all export shipments.
* Execute and support day-to-day export operations deliverables.
* Reconcile and resolve network issues.
* Communicate frequently with sales and support functions.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

**Must Have**

* 2-3 years of experience in the logistics, transport, airline, or BPO industry for Executive/Sr. Executive.
* 3-4 years of experience in the logistics, transport, airline, or BPO industry for AM/DM.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* Basic problem-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.
* Efficiently manage tasks to meet deadlines and priorities.

**Preferred**

* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* EXIM/IATA certification is preferred.

  

**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

* Utilizing Anaplan's value-based selling methodology. Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while nurturing satisfied customers that can be referenced in future sales cycles.

**More about you:**

* 10 plus years of successful Software sales/ SAAS/ PAAS experience with extensive experience selling to Large Enterprise and conglomerates in North.

* Expertise in mobility and digital strategy.
* Executive-level communication and interpersonal skills.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Privacy & AI** **Notice**

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

Ten 11 Hospitality is looking for a highly organised, proactive, and analytical Executive Assistant to the Managing Director to drive operational coordination, cross-functional accountability, and executive-level reporting.

**3. Site Visits & Project Coordination**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Educational Qualification:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Finance, or a related discipline.

title: SDR
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a driven and organized Sales Development Representative (SDR) to manage

and qualify incoming sales leads and convert them into qualified sales opportunities.Your

primary responsibility will be to own incoming leads from the moment they enter the sales

pipeline — contacting prospects quickly, understanding their requirements, qualifying the

opportunity, scheduling product demonstrations, and consistently following up to move

prospects through the sales process.You will act as the first point of contact for prospective

customers and play an important role in ensuring that genuine opportunities do not get lost due

to delayed responses or inadequate follow-up.

Key ResponsibilitiesIncoming Lead Management – Primary Responsibility

● Handle incoming leads generated through the website, marketing campaigns, referrals,

WhatsApp, calls, partnerships, and other lead-generation channels.

● Contact new leads promptly and ensure defined response-time SLAs are consistently

met.

● Conduct initial discovery calls to understand the prospect's company, current processes,

pain points, requirements, and reason for evaluating the product.

● Qualify leads based on defined criteria such as customer profile, use case, company size,

requirement, decision-making process, urgency, and buying intent.

● Identify the relevant decision-makers and stakeholders involved in the purchase.

● Clearly communicate the product's core value proposition and determine whether there is

a potential fit.

● Schedule product demonstrations with qualified prospects and coordinate with the

relevant sales team member.

● Ensure prospects attend scheduled demos through confirmations, reminders, and

rescheduling where required.

● Conduct persistent and structured follow-ups with prospects through calls, WhatsApp,

email, and other appropriate channels.

● Re-engage leads that have gone cold or have stopped responding.

● Maintain complete and accurate records of every lead, interaction, follow-up, qualification

status, and next action in the CRM.

● Ensure no qualified lead is lost because of missed follow-ups or poor lead management.

● Provide clear context and qualification notes when handing qualified opportunities to the

salesperson responsible for closing the deal.

Outbound Prospecting – Secondary ResponsibilityWhen inbound lead volumes permit, the SDR

will also support new business generation by:

● Researching and identifying potential target companies.

● Identifying relevant decision-makers within target accounts.

● Conducting outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other

appropriate channels.

● Qualifying outbound prospects and scheduling meetings or product demonstrations.

● Following up with prospects until they are qualified, disqualified, or moved into a nurture

pipeline.

What We're Looking For

● 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, inside sales, business development, telesales, or

SaaS sales.

● Strong verbal and written communication skills.

● Comfortable speaking with business owners, operations teams, HR teams, and senior

decision-makers.

● Strong questioning and listening skills with the ability to understand a prospect's actual

business problem.

● Excellent follow-up discipline — you should be comfortable contacting a prospect

multiple times across different channels.

● Ability to differentiate between genuine sales opportunities and low-intent enquiries.

● Organized and capable of managing a large number of leads simultaneously without

losing track of follow-ups.

● Comfortable working with defined targets and conversion metrics.

● Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools is preferred.

● Professional communication skills in English and Hindi; additional languages are an

advantage.

Career GrowthStrong performers can progress into roles such as Senior SDR, Account Executive,

Business Development Manager, or Sales Manager, based on performance and demonstrated

ability to manage the sales process.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per hour

Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

***Job Family Definition:***

Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. ***Management Level Definition:***

Applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle most unique situations. May seek advice in order to make decisions on complex business issues.

***The Services Sales Consultant*** is responsible for selling technology, services and/or technology management services (TMS) to end-user customers (and/or partners) in an assigned geographic territory or industry focusing on new business or up-selling within an account. The position requires a solid understanding of the services value proposition and how customers assign services contracts. Knowledge of marketing campaigns to align initiatives with account planning activities is also required. The Services Consultant develops consultative customer proposals, tailoring strategy and solutions to meet the needs of the customer. They understand the customer’s business challenges /objectives to provide value added services and solutions. In some instances these specialists may also be responsible for outsourcing deals.

* Interface with both internal and external/industry experts to anticipate customer needs and facilitate solutions development.Build sales readiness and reduce client learning curve through effective knowledge transfer in area of specialization.

**What you need to bring:**

  

***Education and Experience Required:***

* University or Bachelor's degree preferred.Directly related previous work experience.
* Demonstrated success in achieving progressively higher quota.
* Extensive vertical industry knowledge required.
* Typically 5-8 years advanced sales experience required.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Deep knowledge of products, solution or service offerings as well as competitor's offerings, to be able to sell expansive systems or services and attached products.
* Understands the industry and market segment in which key accounts are situated, and integrates this knowledge into consultative selling.
* Understands the role of IT within area of specialization and how the company's solutions differentially address specific vertical industry challenges as well as their cross-segment capabilities.
* Negotiates and drives deals to ensure successful closes and high win rate.
* Broad understanding of the customer needs; applies standard as well as creative solutions to meet those needs.
* Uses client engagement skills in collaboration with account leads to propose expansive systems or service solutions to client.
* Leadership and initiative in successfully driving specialty sales in accounts - prospecting, negotiating and closing deals.
* Translate product knowledge into customer's added business value.
* Uses specialty knowledge to actively prospects within accounts to discover or cultivate sales opportunities.
Conceptualizes and articulates well-targeted solutions in area of technical specialty* - from proposal to contract sign-off
* Ability to take a deal through the sales cycle including closing or supporting the close of a deal.
* Demonstrates high service knowledge and professionalism in researching and sharing service- related information with account teams and customers.
* Understand the channel and work an effective plan to increase sales with our partners.
* Regular use of Siebel updating deal profile and forecasting accurately.
* Understands services as part of strategic product sales.
* Good prioritization and delegation skills in order to focus on the key client opportunities. Knowledge of industry trends, associated solutions, and key partner/ISV solutions.

· Practical understanding of lead generation, prospect qualification, sales conversion and customer relationship management.

· Comfortable using MS Excel or Google Sheets to maintain sales data and prepare basic reports.

· Achievement of assigned monthly revenue and sales targets.

· Average deal value and sales cycle duration, where applicable.

· Customer handover quality and identification of upselling or cross-selling opportunities.

title: Portfolio IT Executive
description:
**Job Purpose**
---------------

To ensure the smooth functioning of all hotel IT systems, hardware, software, networks, and communication systems. The IT Executive will provide day-to-day technical support to hotel colleagues, maintain system security, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure compliance with IHG IT standards and procedures to support efficient hotel operations and a seamless guest experience.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. IT Operations and Technical Support**

* Maintain and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, servers, network devices, Wi-Fi, and other IT equipment.
* Provide timely technical support to hotel colleagues and resolve hardware and software issues.
* Ensure the smooth functioning of hotel systems, including Property Management Systems (PMS), Point of Sale (POS), email, and other business applications.
* Monitor system performance and escalate unresolved technical issues to the IT Manager or relevant service provider.

**2. Network and Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor hotel LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi connectivity, switches, routers, firewalls, and cabling.
* Ensure the availability and proper functioning of IT infrastructure across hotel departments.
* Maintain updated records of network devices, IT assets, and system configurations.

**3. Information Security and Compliance**

* Follow IHG IT security policies, data protection guidelines, and access control procedures.
* Maintain antivirus and endpoint security updates and support regular system patching.
* Ensure secure access to IT rooms and equipment.
* Support PCI DSS compliance, information security audits, and closure of audit observations.
* Maintain confidentiality of guest, colleague, and business information.

**4. Backup and Business Continuity**

* Perform and monitor regular data backups as per established procedures.
* Assist in testing backup restoration and disaster recovery arrangements.
* Report system failures, security incidents, and potential data loss risks immediately.

**5. IT Asset and Vendor Management**

* Maintain an updated inventory of IT hardware, software, licenses, and accessories.
* Track IT equipment allocation, repairs, warranties, and replacements.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for maintenance and technical support.
* Assist in preventive maintenance and ensure timely resolution of service requests.

**6. Documentation and Training**

* Maintain IT logs, incident registers, maintenance records, and system documentation.
* Assist in implementing IT Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and brand standards.
* Guide hotel colleagues on basic troubleshooting, system usage, cybersecurity, and data security practices.
* Support IT audits, system upgrades, and new technology implementations.

**7. Guest and Business Support**

* Ensure prompt resolution of technology-related issues affecting guest services and hotel operations.
* Provide IT support during peak operational hours and critical hotel activities.
* Coordinate with Front Office, Food & Beverage, Finance, Sales, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, or a similar role; hotel industry experience will be preferred.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, software troubleshooting, Windows operating systems, networking, LAN/WAN, and Wi-Fi.
* Familiarity with PMS, POS, email systems, antivirus software, backups, and IT security practices.
* Good communication, problem-solving, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work in a hospitality environment and respond to operational IT requirements as needed.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Customer service orientation
* Attention to detail
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Time management and responsiveness
* Information security awareness
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

**IHG Values – True Hospitality**
---------------------------------

* **True Attitude:** Demonstrate care and a positive approach while supporting colleagues and guests.
* **True Confidence:** Apply technical knowledge effectively and professionally.
* **True Listening:** Understand user requirements and identify the root cause of issues.
* **True Responsiveness:** Resolve IT issues promptly to minimize disruption to hotel operations.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Job Description (JD) – Dispatch Executive

**Industry:** Wet Wipes Manufacturing / FMCG  
**Department:** Dispatch & Logistics  
**Job Title:** Dispatch Executive

Job Summary

The Dispatch Executive will be responsible for managing the timely and accurate dispatch of finished wet wipes products to customers, distributors, and business partners. The role involves coordinating with the production, quality control, warehouse, sales, and logistics teams to ensure proper order processing, packaging verification, documentation, inventory accuracy, and on-time delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Dispatch Planning & Execution**
* Plan and execute daily dispatches according to customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and production departments to ensure product availability.
* Ensure timely loading and dispatch of wet wipes cartons, cases, and pallets.
* Verify product names, variants, quantities, batch numbers, and expiry dates before dispatch.
* **Documentation & Record Keeping**
* Prepare delivery challans, invoices, e-way bills, packing lists, and other applicable dispatch documents.
* Maintain dispatch registers, vehicle details, transporter records, and proof of delivery (POD).
* Update dispatch entries in ERP software, Excel, or other inventory management systems.
* Maintain accurate records of dispatched goods and pending orders.
* **Quality & Packaging Verification**
* Ensure finished goods are properly packed, sealed, labelled, and ready for transportation.
* Check that wet wipes packs and cartons are not damaged, leaking, or improperly sealed.
* Verify batch details, manufacturing dates, expiry dates, and labelling requirements.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control (QC) team regarding product release and dispatch clearance.
* **Inventory & Warehouse Coordination**
* Maintain accurate finished goods stock records.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles, as applicable, for inventory movement.
* Coordinate with the warehouse team for picking, packing, staging, and loading.
* Report stock shortages, damaged products, and dispatch discrepancies to the concerned department.
* **Transport & Logistics Coordination**
* Arrange vehicles and coordinate with transporters, drivers, and courier partners.
* Ensure proper loading, stacking, and handling to prevent damage during transit.
* Track shipments and communicate delivery status to the sales or customer service team.
* Follow up on delayed deliveries, returned goods, and pending proof of delivery.
* **Reporting & Compliance**
* Prepare daily dispatch reports and pending-order reports.
* Ensure compliance with company dispatch procedures and applicable documentation requirements.
* Report dispatch errors, shortages, damages, and customer complaints to the reporting manager.
* Maintain cleanliness, safety, and proper handling practices in the dispatch area.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate or 12th pass; a diploma in logistics, supply chain, or warehouse management is preferred.
* 1–2 years of experience in dispatch, warehouse operations, or logistics, preferably in FMCG or manufacturing.
* Experience in finished goods dispatch and inventory management will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of GST invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documentation.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/inventory management software.

Required Skills

* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple dispatches and meet delivery deadlines.
* Knowledge of FIFO/FEFO and stock reconciliation.
* Problem-solving skills and a responsible approach to documentation.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* On-time dispatch and delivery performance.
* Accuracy of dispatched quantities and documentation.
* Number of dispatch errors, shortages, and damages.
* Inventory record accuracy.
* Timely submission of dispatch reports and proof of delivery.
* Compliance with packaging and quality release requirements.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
The Account Executive will independently manage day-to-day accounting, billing, inventory reporting and statutory compliance for the Sonepat plant of Kreative Technologies. The role is responsible for accurate and timely invoicing, maintenance of financial records, generation of stock reports, bank compliances, GST returns and PF / ESIC filings, ensuring the company remains fully compliant and audit-ready at all times. The Account Executive works closely with the Production, Stores, Dispatch and Purchase teams and reports directly to the Managing Director.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Billing & Invoicing**

▪ Generate accurate tax invoices, delivery challans, credit / debit notes and job-work challans in Tally Prime.

▪ Generate e-invoices (IRN) and e-way bills for every dispatch and ensure they match the physical despatch.

▪ Coordinate with Dispatch and Sales / CRM teams to ensure same-day billing and correct customer, PO and HSN details.

▪ Maintain customer ledgers and support receivable follow-ups with ageing reports.

**Stock & Inventory Reporting**

▪ Generate monthly stock reports covering raw material (copper, PVC compound, terminals, connectors), WIP and finished goods.

▪ Reconcile stock periodic physical verification and investigate variances.

▪ Prepare MIS reports on sales, purchases, stock and receivables for the Managing Director.

**Bank Compliances**

▪ Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) regularly and resolve unmatched entries.

▪ Prepare and submit monthly stock statements, drawing-power and other periodic returns required by the bank for working-capital limits (CC / OD).

▪ Handle payment processing (NEFT / RTGS), LC documentation and bank correspondence as required.

▪ Support renewal / review of credit facilities with financial data and documents.

**GST & Indirect Tax**

▪ Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B accurately and within due dates; support the annual return (GSTR-9 / 9C).

▪ Reconcile input tax credit with GSTR-2B and follow up with vendors for mismatches.

▪ Respond to GST notices and queries in coordination with the company’s CA.

▪ Ensure correct HSN classification and tax rates on all sales and purchases.

**Payroll Statutory — PF & ESIC**

▪ Compute PF and ESIC contributions from monthly payroll; generate ECR and challans and remit within due dates.

▪ File monthly / periodic PF and ESIC returns; manage UAN and ESIC IP registrations for new joiners and exits.

▪ Maintain statutory registers and records for inspections and audits.

**Documentation & Filing**

▪ Maintain systematic physical and digital filing of invoices, purchase bills, GRNs, vouchers, bank documents and statutory returns.

▪ Ensure all records are complete and ready for statutory, tax and internal audits; coordinate with auditors and the CA.

▪ Support monthly and year-end closing of books.

**Export & Import Documentation (Added Advantage)**

▪ Preparation of export documents — commercial invoice, packing list, shipping bill and certificate of origin.

▪ Filing on ICEGATE / DGFT portals, LUT for zero-rated supplies, and coordination with CHA and freight forwarders.

▪ Import documentation — bill of entry, duty payment and customs clearance follow-up.

▪ Export realisation tracking and documentation with the bank (e-BRC, FIRC).

**QUALIFICATION AND SKILLS**

▪ **Education:** B.Com (mandatory). M.Com / CA Inter will be an added advantage.

▪ **Experience:** Minimum 5 years in accounts, preferably in a manufacturing company.

▪ **Software:** Strong hands-on working knowledge of Tally Prime (billing, inventory and accounting modules) and MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables).

▪ **Statutory Knowledge:** Sound working knowledge of GST, PF, ESIC and the related government portals.

▪ **Banking:** Experience with bank reconciliations, stock statements and working-capital compliances.

▪ **Added Advantage:** Exposure to export / import documentation and customs procedures.

▪ **Personal Attributes:** High integrity and confidentiality, attention to detail, ability to meet deadlines independently, and good communication in Hindi and English.

**ABOUT US**

Founded over **SIX** decades ago to manufacture electrical solutions, we are now leading manufacturers of Power Cords, Wire Harness Assemblies, Power Cables, Single Core Industrial Cables, Battery Wire, Rigid PVC Conduit, Casing & Capping and PVC Tape. **SAFECORD** is an integral part of the **Kalinga Premium Group**, which has a detailed supply network throughout the nation and continuously exports to Africa and North America. Kreative Technologies, established in 2009, manufactures SAFECORD wire harnesses, SAFECORD multi-core power cords and SAFECORD control cables. Equipped with advanced, technologically superior equipment, its supply network spans various industries. The company is continuously involved in product upgradation and new product development, and its engineers work in partnership with customers to provide the best possible solutions.

Purpose of the position

  

To manage the ocean freight global accounts as a single window for customer correspondence, operations and to achieve operational excellence and higher productivity through timely & accurate documentation, operations and OSC functions and effective coordination with outsourced service providers/vendors.

* Create docket/file and review documentation with booking form, covering Shipper's Letter of Instruction (SLI) and/or Letter of Credit for accuracy

* Communicate and resolve with the customer on exceptions and incidents – Invoice, Service Irregularities & Claims Management

**Vendors**

**Systems & Documentation**

* Create booking / shipment CW1.
* Prepare and issue documentation as per Documentation Check Sheet, Customer Profile, SLI and/or L/C.
* Ensure that file contains all necessary pre-shipment document copies in proper sequence and handover the file to document processing.
* Submit ACD / AMS / ACS transmission on time, verify results and make corrections if necessary
* Achieve “Operational Excellence” through accurate and timely documentation / system updates resulting in increased productivity and data quality.
* Achieving Global Operational KPIs– Data Quality, Mandatory Fields, Workflow & Milestones.
* Posting of Vendor Invoices thru Web cost portal correctly & timely.
* Closing Job files within the agreed timeframe by posting all costs received from various vendors and allocating agreed revenue/Sell rates as per set KPIs.
* Proper input of cost / revenue/ WIP / Accruals
* Handling Invoice Disputes through proper mechanism & ensure timely closure.
* Sending pre-advise with complete and accurate documents to network overseas / destination office.
* Ensure proper information flow with department staff on updates, changes, market trends/requirements etc.
* Helping Team with Shipping Line or co-loaders for documentation.
* Escalate wherever necessary.

**Coordination**

* Lead the entire Operations and documentation Team.
* Follow-up for pre-alert.
* Follow-up with other branches for Cargo coming from various locations.
* Follow-up with shipping line for Tracking of shipment.
* Providing Stuffing instructions to Operation Executive at CFS.
* Proper input of cost / revenue/ WIP / Accruals
* Ability to maintain stable performance under pressure or opposition; handling stress in a manner that is acceptable to others and the organization.
* Respond to inquiries from the field sales team and clients, providing accurate and timely information and advice on Customs related issues and other compliance queries.
* Effectively present information one-on-one, or in small group situations.
* Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner.

Decision Making Authority

  

Decision making on work execution except for the financial aspects, depending on the urgency and importance, keeping the line manager informed formally.

  

Function / Market & Industry Knowledge / Business Acumen / Process working

  

* Expertise in Freight Forwarding

* Understanding of DSV strategy and products.
* Knowledge about markets and competitors.
* Knowledge about trends and challenges in the industry.
* Business administration competence
* Negotiation skills
* Overall understanding of business processes and interdependencies.
* Knowledge in freight forwarding and logistics
* International mobility

Skills & Competencies

  

**RESULT ORIENTATION**

* Ready to take personal accountability for achieving individual and shared goals
* Ability to set robust plans well in advance and to initiate action to move projects forward
* Planning & Organizing (Ability to prioritize, plan, assign & control)
* High result orientation and customer focus

**CUSTOMER ORIENTATION**

* Readiness to provide alternatives and optimized solutions to the Customer

**PERSONAL**

title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  
  
AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.
  
  
AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.
  
  
Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
* Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
* Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
* Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
* Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
* Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
* Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
* Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
* Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
* Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

  
A day in the life  
As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.
  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent
* 10+ years of experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with or having knowledge of cloud computing and existing cloud technologies
* Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning
* Experience in making data driven business decisions

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Store & Inventory Management**

* Maintain **100% inventory accuracy** through systematic stock-taking, cycle counting, and ledger reconciliations.
* Organize and maintain the physical store layout for optimal storage, easy retrieval, and safety of sensitive electronic components, finished IoT devices, and raw materials.
* Implement robust Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or ERP-driven tracking procedures to monitor stock levels in real time.
* Prevent stock obsolescence, shrinkage, or damage through proactive stock rotations and secure storage practices.

**2. Inward and Outward Dispatches**

* Supervise all **inward shipments**, ensuring rigorous quality checks on incoming raw materials, components, and vendor supplies against purchase orders (POs).
* Manage **outward dispatches** for B2B clients, field deployments, and e-commerce channels, ensuring timely, secure, and cost-effective shipping.
* Coordinate with third-party logistics (3PL) partners and courier services to ensure hassle-free final-mile delivery.
* Ensure all dispatch documentation (eway bills, tax invoices, delivery challans, and packing slips) is meticulously generated and archived.

**3. RTO (Return to Origin) Management**

* Streamline the **RTO and reverse logistics process** by efficiently tracking, receiving, and inspecting returned shipments from clients or transit hubs.
* Categorize returned devices based on condition (e.g., for restocking, refurbishment, or scrapping) and coordinate with the technical/repair teams for rapid turnaround.
* Maintain comprehensive logs and metrics for RTO rates, identifying root causes to minimize future delivery failures.

**4. Internal Device Movement & Inter-Departmental Coordination**

* Track and oversee the issuance, transfer, and return of devices across internal departments (**R&D, Production, QA, and Sales/Demo teams**).
* Maintain strict chain-of-custody logs for prototype hardware, testing units, and high-value demonstration kits moving within the organization.
* Conduct regular internal audits to reconcile physical assets assigned to various teams versus system records.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience:** 2 to 4 years of proven experience in warehouse management, storekeeping, or inventory control, preferably within a hardware, electronics, or IoT manufacturing setup.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Technical Skills:**

Proficiency in using ERP systems, WMS software, and advanced MS Excel.

Strong understanding of barcode scanning, inventory tagging, and SKU management.

**Core Competencies:**

Excellent organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail.

Strong problem-solving abilities regarding logistics bottlenecks and transit discrepancies.

Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with fast-paced engineering and sales teams.

title: Real Estate Sales Consultant
description:
1. Job Overview

We are looking for ambitious, confident, and result-oriented individuals to join our Real Estate Sales Team. The selected candidates will be responsible for identifying potential property buyers, generating and managing leads, understanding customer requirements, presenting suitable real estate projects, conducting site visits, and converting prospective clients into successful bookings.

This opportunity is ideal for candidates who want to build a long-term career in real estate sales and earn significantly more through performance-based incentives in addition to their fixed monthly salary.

**Our compensation structure offers a fixed monthly salary along with attractive, uncapped performance-based incentives, subject to the company's applicable incentive policy.** Candidates who demonstrate strong sales skills, consistent follow-up, and successful deal closures can increase their overall earnings based on their performance.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Lead Generation & Prospecting

* Generate new business opportunities through outbound calls, referrals, networking, online platforms, and other lead-generation activities.
* Contact potential property buyers, investors, and customers interested in purchasing residential or commercial properties.
* Respond promptly to incoming enquiries and qualify leads based on budget, location, property preferences, and purchasing timelines.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers.
* Identify potential investors and high-intent buyers to maximize sales opportunities.

B. Client Handling & Property Consultation

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable properties based on their needs and budget.
* Explain project specifications, property features, amenities, location advantages, pricing, payment plans, and availability.
* Provide accurate information about the buying process and coordinate with the relevant internal teams for additional details.
* Build trust with prospective customers through professional communication and timely follow-ups.
* Address customer questions, objections, and concerns effectively.

C. Site Visits & Property Presentations

* Schedule and coordinate property site visits with interested clients.
* Accompany customers during site visits and explain the project's features, amenities, and selling points.
* Present the property's benefits in line with customer requirements.
* Follow up after site visits to understand customer feedback, resolve concerns, and move prospects towards booking.
* Maintain accurate records of scheduled, completed, and follow-up site visits.

D. Sales Conversion & Deal Closure

* Convert qualified leads into site visits, bookings, and successful property transactions.
* Negotiate with customers within approved pricing and commercial guidelines.
* Explain booking procedures, payment schedules, and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate with the sales management, CRM, accounts, and documentation teams during the booking process.
* Maintain regular communication with customers until the deal is successfully closed.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and customer referrals.

E. Reporting & Performance Management

* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, and deal progress.
* Update the company's CRM or sales tracking system regularly.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic sales-performance updates to the reporting manager.
* Participate in team meetings, sales reviews, product training, and performance discussions.
* Follow company policies, professional standards, and approved sales practices.

3. Salary Structure & Incentive Opportunities

The company offers a combination of fixed monthly compensation and performance-based incentives.

Compensation ComponentDetailsFixed Monthly SalaryGuaranteed fixed salary as specified in the offer letter, subject to applicable employment termsSales IncentivesAdditional earnings based on eligible sales and the company's incentive structureHigh Performance RewardsAdditional rewards or bonuses, if applicable under company policyCareer GrowthOpportunities to progress into senior sales and team-leadership rolesWhy This Opportunity Is Attractive

* **Fixed Salary:** Earn a stable monthly salary in addition to sales incentives.
* **High Incentive Potential:** Increase your earnings through successful bookings and eligible sales performance.
* **No Stated Incentive Ceiling:** Incentive earnings may grow with performance where the applicable company policy provides uncapped incentives.
* **Performance Recognition:** Strong performers may be considered for additional rewards under company policy.
* **Career Advancement:** Opportunities to grow into Senior Sales Executive, Team Leader, and Sales Manager positions.

*The applicable incentive rates, qualifying conditions, payment timelines, and any caps or thresholds will be communicated transparently by the company. Incentives are subject to the written incentive policy and eligible sales outcomes.*

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong convincing, negotiation, and deal-closing abilities.
* Customer-focused approach and professional relationship management.
* Confidence in interacting with customers from different backgrounds.
* Strong follow-up, lead-management, and prospecting skills.
* Ability to understand customer needs and present appropriate property solutions.
* Self-motivation and a target-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with the sales team.
* Good time management and organizational skills.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and property site visits.

5. Eligibility & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills, confidence, and an interest in sales are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with experience in real estate, property sales, channel sales, banking, insurance, automobile sales, or business development will have an advantage.
* Prior real estate sales experience is preferred but not mandatory unless specified for a particular opening.
* Candidates should be comfortable with client interaction, regular follow-ups, field visits, and performance-based sales objectives.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated using relevant metrics, including:

* Number of leads contacted and qualified.
* Number of client follow-ups completed.
* Number of site visits scheduled and conducted.
* Lead-to-site-visit conversion rate.
* Site-visit-to-booking conversion rate.
* Monthly sales and revenue achievement.
* Number and value of successful bookings.
* Customer satisfaction and referral generation.
* Accuracy of CRM updates and sales reporting.

7. Training & Career Development

Selected candidates will receive relevant training on property projects, product knowledge, sales communication, lead management, customer handling, site visits, negotiation, and the booking process.

High-performing employees may have opportunities to advance into senior sales and team-management positions based on performance, leadership ability, and business requirements.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for individuals who are ambitious, persuasive, hardworking, and motivated by earning potential. The ideal candidate should be comfortable communicating with prospective buyers, building relationships, conducting site visits, following up consistently, and working towards sales targets.

Candidates who want a stable fixed salary with the opportunity to earn additional income through performance-based incentives are encouraged to apply.
